buyer_added_terms.text: OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Quality and BIS/ISI Certification: All plumbing materials, including pipes (PVC/CPVC/UPVC/GI), fitting s, taps, valves, and sanitary wares, must strictly conform to the latest Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS/ISI). Substandard, unbranded, or duplicate items will be outrightly rejected. The pipes must have the ISI mark, manufacturer's name, lot number, and pressure class clearly printed/embossed on them. 2. Brand Specification and Quality Assurance: The bidder must supply only premium, nationally reco gnized, and approved brands (e.g., Supreme, Prince, Jaquar, Cera, Hindware, or equivalent as specified in the BOQ). Supply of local or unbranded items will lead to the rejection of the entire consignment. The buye r reserves the right to verify the authenticity of the material directly with the Original Equipment Manufact urer (OEM). 3. Material Durability and Pressure Ratings: All pipes and fittings must strictly meet the required pre ssure ratings (e.g., SDR 11, SDR 13.5, Schedule 40/80) and dimensions mentioned in the BOQ. They must be leak-proof, corrosion-resistant, lead-free (especially for drinking water applications), and free from any manufacturing defects such as cracks, uneven thickness, or poor threading. 4. Warranty and Guarantee: The supplier must provide a minimum onsite warranty of 2 Year (or as spe cified in the OEM's policy) against any manufacturing defects, leakages, or malfunctioning of fittings, taps, and sanitary items. Any defective item found during installation or within the warranty period must be repl aced free of cost by the seller within 5 working days. 5. Safe Delivery and Transit Damage: The bidder shall be fully responsible for the safe loading, unloadi ng, and transit of the plumbing materials. Any physical damage, breakage, or missing items found during t he Consignee Receipt and Acceptance (CRAC) inspection will be the sole responsibility of the seller, and th e damaged materials must be replaced immediately. .
